O.outcome_detail: AI-TPACK capacity

cells.quote: Paired-sample t-tests demonstrated significant intervention effects across multiple dimensions (Table 4). Most notably, AI-TPACK capacity (d = 0.70), IPACK agent creation capacity (d = 0.86), and AI attitude toward sustained use (d = 0.58) all showed medium to large effect sizes.
cells.note: Cycle 2 used pre-post measures within a separate cohort; post-tests were administered immediately upon workshop completion.

O.outcome_detail: attitude toward sustained AI teaching-assistant use

O.outcome_detail: willingness to sustain AI agent use

cells.quote: Notably, when controlling for baseline capacity, SDT's association with willingness (AI attitude) remained significant (r_partial = .521, p = .032), whereas post-intervention TPACK showed only a weak, non-significant association (r_partial = .378, p = .134).
cells.note: This is an associative post-intervention analysis, not a randomized comparison; SDT need satisfaction was measured post-only and the correlation controlled for baseline capacity.
